lesson_title: LESSON 07: Sharing the Road & Special Circumstances
topic_title: Laws for Sharing the Road — Bikes, Trucks & Horses
prompt: What is commercial truck 'off-tracking' and why does it endanger motorists during turns?

options.text: Commercial truck tires slide sideways whenever traveling across bridge decks
The electronic satellite navigation system loses tracking in rural regions
Truck cargo shifts balance rapidly, tipping the trailer into oncoming lanes
Rear trailer wheels track closer to the curb than front wheels during turns
